name: local-forwarder-mac
description: A local HTTP, HTTPS, and TZT forwarding service for Intel Mac
author: Local Forwarder

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --config vite.config.ts" "npm run build:electron && wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:electron && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test $(rg --files test -g '*.test.ts' | sort)
scripts.package:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir --x64 && node scripts/create-dmg.mjs && npm run verify:package
